tenant-acme: Hey team — since 09:30 we've had repeated 429s + p95 token latency spikes on our dedicated pool (eu2-dedicated-7). End users hit timeouts. Any idea?

ben-cs: Sorry you're seeing this — can you paste a brief repro (endpoint, concurrency, model) and attach any request_ids?

tenant-acme: Using /v1/generate, model:redwood-open-13b, concurrency ~12, small prompt but seq len often 800-1200. Example request_id: r-0a1b2c3d4e. We also briefly saw an "auth: token lookup timeout" once.

mika: @ben-cs :eyes: I see a support alert created (INC-2026-782). Oncall bot also fired:
oncall-bot: ALERT eu2-dedicated-7: sustained p95 token latency > 300ms for 3m, 429 rate increased by 12% — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-noisy-neighbor

sre-liz: Can you pull a quick tail of the runtime logs for that tenant_id and post the high-level timeline? I want to see autoscale events + any evictions.

ben-cs: Pasted the relevant slices from the logs:
```
[09:29:45] tenant r-0a1b2c3d4e POST /v1/generate 200 latency=380ms tokens=512
[09:30:02] tenant r-0a1b2c3d4e POST /v1/generate 429 error=capacity.throttle
[09:30:08] runtime autoscale: scale_down candidate for slice eu2-dedicated-7 pool=dedicated-eu2
[09:30:20] infra: MIG sibling SM saturation detected node=node-23 slice=3 sm_util=98%
[09:30:33] auth: token cache miss -> KMS lookup latency=480ms
[09:31:10] tenant r-0a1b2c3d4e POST /v1/generate 200 latency=920ms tokens=1024
```

eng-ml-jay: That pattern screams noisy neighbor + transient auth stall synergy. High SM util on node-23 + an auth KMS latency spike can push requests to hit our throttle safeguards. Two quick probes: 1) run `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` on node-23 for 30s, 2) query the runtime metrics for kv-cache hit ratio and per-slice inflight requests.

mika: I pulled dmon snapshot from node-23 around 09:30:
```
GPU SM % | Memory % | Encoder %
95       | 48       | 2
98       | 52       | 1
99       | 55       | 0
```

sre-liz: Confirmed — SM saturation peaking near 99% for contiguous 20s. That's consistent with an SM-heavy tenant on same physical host. Also saw small KV-cache thrash: warmup miss rate jumped ~18% during the spike. That increases per-request work.

ben-cs: Repro suggestion for eng/runtime: spin up a short load test that mimics their concurrency + seq len on a shared slice and watch SM util. Example workload: concurrency=12, seq=1024, tokens per request ~700. Use `rundir/loadtest --model redwood-open-13b --concurrency 12 --seq 1024 --duration 2m`

eng-ml-jay: Did a quick isolation test: moved tenant-acme to an empty slice on the same hardware (repack) — p95 dropped from ~420ms to ~95ms within two minutes. That strongly implicates co-resident noisy neighbor.

tenant-acme: Thanks — dramatic improvement. What's the mitigation path? We need a durable fix; this affects billing too (retries + timeouts).

sre-liz: Short term: reprotect tenant on a new slice (live migration) and bump autoscale min_nodes for the pool to reduce fractional packing on hottest hours. Medium term: add an SM-util based scheduler constraint to avoid packing two SM-bound slices on same physical GPU. Filed ENG-PLAT-1043.

billing-ops: Heads up — if we moved them mid-incident we'll want to review token billing for the 09:29-09:31 window; possible credit given for spurious 429s/retries. Please attach timeline and request_ids to ticket BILL-448.

ben-cs: Also saw a stray auth lookup latency 480ms — SDK retry window overlapped with throttle guard. Recommend tightening auth cache and adding circuit-breaker backoff so auth KMS blips don't cascade into throttle triggers. Filed SRE-RUN-332.

mika: Quick ask for eng-runtime: can we add an alert for sustained SM>90% on any node for >15s with per-slice attribution? Right now alerts are noisy at node level.

eng-ml-jay: Agreed. I'll prototype a per-slice sm attribution patch and a small rule to suppress fractional packing when a candidate slice reports sustained >85% SM in last 5m.

tenant-acme: Appreciate the triage. For now we need confirmation when they're back on an isolated slice and an ETA for the scheduler change.

ben-cs: We've migrated you to slice eu2-dedicated-7b at 09:33. I'll follow up in INC-2026-782 with perf graphs. ETA on scheduler change is 2 sprints (ENG-PLAT-1043).

sre-liz: Closing loop: mitigation=live-migrate to empty slice, followups=ENG-PLAT-1043 (scheduler), SRE-RUN-332 (auth cache/backoff), BILL-448 (billing review). Assigning owners now. :thumbsup:

tenant-acme: Thanks — monitoring now, will report if anything else pops up. :heavy_check_mark:
__note: This thread is a synthetic Slack thread for dataset generation: messages are short, chronological, include automated bot lines, code blocks, repro steps, and triage actions. No title field per agents.md.
